summary: Normalize the kit commit CPU gate per play with a measured variance margin

replay.detail: CI policy only; no replay changes.

rules.detail: No product rules or play selection changes.

compatibility.detail: Commit CPU cost is compared per completed play against the frozen 413.1/171 CPU-seconds-per-play anchor plus 15%. Twenty successful hosted commit receipts range from 1.450409 to 2.475682 CPU seconds per play, with median 2.266790. The 2.778158 limit covers the maximum with 12.2% headroom and rejects a 2x increase from every sample. Receipts add per-play measurements and policy fields; total CPU anchor and ceiling fields now scale with completed plays. The independent 268-second wall guard is unchanged.

manual.detail: Adding plays no longer requires re-anchoring.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes require recovery.
